entries.summary: OpenCode Go profiles may set pi_model.providerId to opencode-go with an explicit openai-completions API to enable Pi reasoning_content replay and session headers on RPC and durable lanes. Other models must omit it; existing profiles need no change. Saving it changes the exact profile hash. The prepared lane refuses it, and keys-profile RPC launches refuse model-runtime composition errors instead of using a built-in fallback.

The retention class agent-runtime-sessions is replaced by the expiring class codex-session-store: it is removed from PROTECTED_CLASS_IDS, ProtectedClassId and PROTECTED_CLASS_BOUNDS and added to EXPIRING_CLASS_IDS and ExpiringClassId, so replace the literal where the Host reads retention classes and treat the class as expiring. It covers the Codex rollouts that agentUserContext: excluded keeps under <Agent home>/.byok/codex. A rollout is deleted once its last write is older than the new DaemonConfig.storage.retention.ttlMs['codex-session-store'] (default 31 days, or the session-ledger TTL plus one day if longer; an explicit value must be at least that), unless a live session ledger still names its thread or its Agent home is running a task. Rollouts that used to stay until the Host removed the Agent home are now deleted by default; set the TTL higher to keep idle threads longer. Resuming a deleted thread fails closed through the existing non-retryable missing-thread path.

Direct callers of openAgentMemoryFilesystemHelper must pass the required ancestorRoot from the canonical AgentHomeResolution.hostStorageRoot that owns canonicalHome. Upgrade the daemon and its SDK helper assets together: open requires protocol 4 and ancestorRoot, reports helper version 4, and rejects every other request/response protocol or helper version without a protocol-3 reader or default root. Source integrations using helperAgentMemoryIntentBackend must pass ancestorRoot second and move optional assetRoot to third. hostStorageRoot must already exist durably before the first open; creating that root is outside the barrier and tracked in #1652. Windows intent B remains false pending A7 recovery evidence.

Fix: the hosted Host (examples/hosted-bot-collaboration) now enforces Bot autonomy as the local Host does. An observing Bot records would-do entities instead of running create_routine, a cross-Bot delegate or room_call. A Host that vendors the example runs HostedCollaborationStore.migrate() once on every existing schema before the new code serves (it replaces entity_kind_check and moves any wouldDo rows left in a scope frame by an older L import into would_do entity rows), then calls setBotAutonomy(credential, botId, 'auto') for each Bot that must keep acting on its own.
agy, dsh and Hermes accept fractional interruptTimeoutMs; session limits are defined once across six adapters.

DiagnosticsSnapshot.health gains an optional controlEndpointRefusal (code, path, recording time) on its valid branch. byok-agent doctor reports a typed control endpoint refusal instead of daemon offline. No Host change is required.
